page_title: EVE 2-0 SOU | Everton v Southampton 18/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+4' Jack Harrison (Everton) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90+1' William Smallbone (Southampton) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' A yellow card for a tackle by James Garner (Everton). Michael Oliver doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
87' What a chance that is! Ross Stewart (Southampton) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header just over the crossbar.
85' Jordan Pickford pulls off a great save to deny Cameron Archer (Southampton), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
82' Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) is being substituted because of an injury. Simon Rusk sends Joachim Kayi Sanda on the pitch.
81' The game is interrupted now, Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
80' Michael Oliver shows the yellow card to Flynn Downes (Southampton) for a heavy challenge.
79' Ashley Young (Everton) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
76' Southampton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
75' The attendance is 39201.
75' David Moyes has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) replacing Iliman Ndiaye.
74' Here's the change. Jarrad Branthwaite leaves the pitch and Michael Keane (Everton) comes on as a substitute.
73' The resulting set piece from Southampton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
72' Looks like Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
70' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
69' Welington (Southampton) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Michael Oliver has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jay Robinson (Southampton) comes onto the pitch so that Tyler Dibling can be given a rest.
67' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
67' James Bree (Southampton) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
65' David Moyes decides to make a substitution. Abdoulaye Doucoure will be replaced by Carlos Alcaraz (Everton).
65' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Dwight McNeil as he is replaced by Jack Harrison (Everton).
63' Southampton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
63' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Southampton.
62' Ross Stewart (Southampton) unleashes a decent strike heading to the bottom right corner, but the keeper dives like Superman and keeps it out. Southampton have a corner.
60' The substitution has been made. Ross Stewart (Southampton) has replaced Kamaldeen Sulemana.
60' It will be a substitution. Cameron Archer (Southampton) is ready to enter the pitch as Nathan Wood walks off.
60' Simon Rusk prepares a substitution. Joe Aribo is replaced by William Smallbone (Southampton).
59' Ashley Young (Everton) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
57' Beto (Everton) leaps highest in the middle of the box to meet a lofted ball and powers a header at a goal, but unfortunately for him it flies just over the bar.
56' James Garner (Everton) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Aaron Ramsdale makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the roof of the net.
54' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) is able to continue to play.
52' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
52' The resulting corner from James Garner (Everton) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
51' Dwight McNeil (Everton) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety. Everton earn a corner.
51' Ashley Young (Everton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The linesman makes the right call and Everton will have a corner.
49' Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
48' James Garner (Everton) brings an opponent down and Michael Oliver interrupts the game.
47' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Michael Oliver sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
45+3' The Everton players halt their celebrations as referee Michael Oliver makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
45+2' 2 - 0 Dwight McNeil passes to Iliman Ndiaye (Everton), who gets one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy grounds the keeper and he has a simple task lifting the ball over him into the net.
45+1' Aaron Ramsdale is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Beto (Everton). Easy save!
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Welington (Southampton) is penalised for holding. Michael Oliver signals a set piece.
42' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety.
40' Ashley Young (Everton) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
39' James Bree (Southampton) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
38' Michael Oliver blows his whistle and it's Beto (Everton) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
37' The ball is cleared after James Garner (Everton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
36' The Everton players are exchanging some short passes.
33' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Beto (Everton) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.

32' Tyler Dibling (Southampton) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Michael Oliver blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
30' Beto (Everton) has a goal ruled out for offside!
28' Jack Stephens (Southampton) commits a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul. Everton are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
27' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
26' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
24' Welington (Southampton) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
21' Jake O'Brien (Everton) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the left post.
20' Dwight McNeil (Everton) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

20' Ambitious effort from Beto (Everton). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post.
18' Seamus Coleman goes off the pitch and Ashley Young (Everton) comes on.
17' Tyler Dibling (Southampton) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
15' Dwight McNeil (Everton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
12' Flynn Downes (Southampton) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
11' Dwight McNeil (Everton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Aaron Ramsdale, who smothers the ball.
9' Southampton enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
6' 1 - 0 What a beauty from just outside the box! Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom left corner.
5' Beto (Everton) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the middle of the goal, but Aaron Ramsdale keeps it out with an amazing save.
4' Dwight McNeil (Everton) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
4' Seamus Coleman (Everton) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
2' James Garner (Everton) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
1' The first half has started.
Southampton will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Michael Oliver.
